ACT XXIII OF 2011
ACT XXIII OF 2011
SINDH LAND REVENUE (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2011
An Act to amend the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
15th July, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-24/2011, dated 15-7-2011.---The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Bill, 2011 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 13th
July, 2011 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 14th July, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Land Revenue Act,
1967, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh
Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967

Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Land Revenue Act,
1967, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of the Sind Land
Revenue Act, 1967.---In the Sind
Land Revenue Act,1967, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, throughout the
Act -
(i) for the word "Sind",
the word "Sindh" shall be substituted;
(ii) for the words
"an deh", the words "a deh" shall be substituted;
(iii) for the words
"Executive District Officer (Revenue)", the word
"Commissioner" shall be substituted;
(iv) for the words
"District Officer (Revenue)", the word "Collector" shall be
substituted;
(v) for the words
"Assistant District Officer (Revenue)", the words "Assistant
Collector" shall be substituted;
(vi) for the word
"District", the original nomenclature "Division" and
"District" shall stand revived;
(vii) for the word "Taluka", the original nomenclature
"Sub-Division" and "Taluka" shall
stand revived.

4. Amendment of section 5 of the Sindh
Land Revenue Act, 1967.---In the said Act, for section 5, the following shall be
substituted:-
"5. Province
to be divided into Divisions.--There shall be as many Divisions in the
Province, with such limits and such areas, as Government may, by notification,
direct.".

on 14th July, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Land Revenue Act,
1967, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
"Chapter-II
Divisions and Districts".
5. Amendment of section 6 of the Sindh
Land Revenue Act, 1967.---In the said Act, for section 6, the following shall be
substituted:-
"6. Divisions to be divided into Districts and
Districts into Sub-Divisions.---(1) Each Division shall be divided into
such Districts, and each District may be divided into such Sub-Divisions or Talukas, as Government may, by notification, specify; and
each Sub-Division may consist of such Talukas, and
having such limits, as Government may, by notification, direct.
(2) Government may, by notification, vary the
number and limits of Divisions, Districts, Sub-Divisions or Talukas
in the Province.".

6. Amendment of section 7 of the Sindh
Land Revenue Act, 1967.---In the said
Act, for section 7, the following shall be substituted:-
"7. Classes
of Revenue Officers.---(1) There shall be the following classes of Revenue
Officers, namely :-
(a) the Board of
Revenue;
(b) the Commissioner;
(c) the Collector;
(d) the Assistant
Collector of the first grade;
(e) the Assistant
Collector of the second grade.
(2) The Deputy Commissioner of the District or
the officer performing for the time being functions as such, shall be the
Collector thereof.".

Preamble.---Whereas

7. Amendment of section 8 of the Sindh
Land Revenue Act, 1967.---In the said
Act, for section 8, the following shall be substituted:-
"8. Appointment
of Commissioners and Collectors.---For each Division there shall be
a Commissioner, and in each District there shall be a Collector, who shall be appointed by
Government, and who shall exercise throughout the Division or District, as the
case may be, all the powers, and discharge all the duties, of the Commissioner
or Collector, as the case may be, under this Act".

Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Land Revenue Act,

It is hereby enacted as follows:-
"Chapter-II
Divisions and Districts".
8. Amendment of section 9 of the Sindh
Land Revenue Act, 1967.---In the said
Act, for section 9, the following shall be substituted:-
"9. Additional
Commissioners and Additional Collectors.-- Government may appoint in any
Division an Additional Commissioner or in any District an Additional Collector,
who shall exercise throughout the Division or District concerned all or any of
the powers and discharge all or any of the duties conferred or imposed on a
Commissioner or Collector, as the case may be, by or under this Act, subject to
the general supervision and control of the Commissioner of the Division in the
case of Additional Commissioner, and the Collector of the District in the case
of Additional Collector.".
